title: Canned association suggester: derive concept, story and Reference candidates from an item's own text
description: Today an outside agent must invent search phrases for 'papyrus knowledge concepts search' and 'stories suggest-links' only works from concepts already tagged (and only for Stories). Smallest gap: one read-only command 'papyrus stories suggest-associations --story X' (and '--reference X') that (1) builds ONE query from title + summary + first N words of body + existing concept names, (2) embeds it once server-side (like searchReferences, so no OPENAI key in the editor lane) and ranks Concepts (concept_card vectors) and accepted References, (3) feeds the top Concepts as virtual seeds into the existing suggest_links graph pass so Stories/Posts/References get ranked even before any tag exists, (4) prints ready link-concept/link-story commands. Reuses link_suggestions.suggest_links, concept_search.search_concepts and reference_suggestions (reference_summary vector as query for a Reference). Needs a server-side concept-vector query field (follow-up already named in docs/story-reporting.md). Also: stories suggest-links takes only a Story today; no read-only Reference equivalent ('references suggest-links' writes suggested rows and needs the vector index lane). Background: PR skills-associations.
